## Restoring Form and Function

UCI Plastic Surgery is proud to serve our community with reconstructive surgery for pediatric and
adult patients. We offer complete reconstructive services for both pediatric and adult patients,
including cancer reconstruction, congenital reconstruction, craniofacial procedures, burn
reconstruction, breast reconstruction, and hand surgery. It is our surgical team’s belief if you are
expertly trained in reconstructive surgery you are going to be equally skilled at treating aesthetic
patient requests, as both patients want to look good after they’ve had a procedure.
* [ Facial Reconstruction ][152]

* [ Breast Reconstruction ][154]

[ See All Reconstructive Procedures ][155]
[ Watch Video [Gordon Lee, MD] ][156]

“Breast cancer is a major problem in the United States, one out of every eight women will develop
breast cancer.” ~Dr. Gordon Lee

## Non-Surgical Aesthetic Options

Not everyone needs surgery to achieve their goals. When a UCI plastic surgeon determines surgery is
not the right choice for a patient during consultation we do so because we embrace the philosophy of
always doing what is in the best interest of the patient. The good news for our patients is we have
numerous non-surgical options to help you achieve your goals without surgery.

We offer a comprehensive range of aesthetic treatments, from facial fillers and neurotoxins like
BOTOX® Cosmetic to advanced laser resurfacing and fat transfer for the face and breast. In addition,
we proudly carry the ZO® Skin Health skincare line, known for its scientifically-backed formulations
designed to promote healthy, radiant skin at every stage of your skincare journey.

[ View Non-Surgical Procedures ][157]

## Exceptional Results. Individualized Patient Care

During your consultation, your surgeon will learn about your areas of concern and work with you to
customize a unique treatment plan. This will incorporate your appearance goals and anatomy to
achieve natural-looking results that enhance your bone structure, ethnicity, and face and body
characteristics.

In reconstructive procedures, we strive to restore form and function, improving patients’ ease of
movement and ability to enjoy life while meeting your aesthetic goals. From consultation to
post-operative care, we do everything we can to make patients feel safe and confident in their
decision to have surgery at UCI Plastic Surgery.

absolute flatness in every unit we produce, delivering reliability you can count on.

## Your Partner for Motion Control, Fluid Power, and Automation.

Youngblood Automation brings over 50 years of experience to the pneumatic, hydraulic,
electromechanical, safety, vision, and robotic automation industry. Youngblood Automation provides
solutions that enhance efficiency, reliability, and performance in a wide-variety of industries,
including industrial, automotive, factory automation, aerospace, defense, consumer goods, food &
packaging, steel, medical, and mobile. As a stocking distributor of leading component manufacturers,
with comprehensive application engineering and manufacturing capabilities, we are the ideal partner
for your motion control, fluid control, and automation requirements.

## Youngblood Automation Engineered Solutions 

At Youngblood Automation, we design and build durable, adaptable custom solutions to meet your exact
needs. From simple workstations, shelving, and protective enclosures to advanced robotic cell
guarding and conveyor systems, our expert Engineered Solutions team collaborates with you to create
the perfect fit.

We partner with leading manufacturers like MayTec and Troax to deliver high-quality components for
automation and industrial applications. With our expertise and industry-leading partners, we bring
your vision to life—delivering innovative, high-performance solutions that enhance safety,
efficiency, and productivity 

[Explore Our Solutions][46]

## Youngblood Automation Value Added Engineering 

At Youngblood Automation, we deliver innovative solutions to meet the ever-evolving demands of
automation. With deep industry expertise, we help optimize performance, enhance reliability, and
extend the lifespan of your automation systems. From pneumatics and hydraulics to motion control,
vision, safety, and robotics, our engineering team identifies opportunities and overcomes challenges
to keep your operations running efficiently. 
* Industrial Hydraulics & Lubrication 
* Mobile Products 
* Motion Control & Automation 
* Pneumatics & Fluid Control 

[Explore Our Solutions][47]

## Youngblood Automation Solutions

### Motion Control & Automation

Youngblood Automation is dedicated to helping our clients keep up with the ever-changing demands of
automation with solutions tailored to their unique performance objectives and budgetary constraints.
Our engineering team can help simplify your application and fulfill even the most complex system
with our motion control solutions and components.

### Industrial/Mobile Hydraulics Systems & Lubrication

With more than five decades of experience and access to a wide range of manufacturer components,
Youngblood Automation can serve your needs across industrial or mobile hydraulics systems and
lubrication. Offering hydraulic power units, electro-hydraulic controls, manifold assemblies,
lubrication and filtration systems, and more. When you work with Youngblood Automation you can be
confident that your solution is engineered and tested to address your specific application needs.

### Safety, Sensors & Vision

Ensure the protection of your industrial operations with Youngblood Automation's advanced safety,
sensors, and vision solutions. Whether it be in manufacturing or logistics automation, our team's
expertise guarantees effective process control that prioritizes safety for individuals and the
environment. Count on our dedication to providing groundbreaking solutions customized to your
automation requirements. With our knowledgeable team, you can expect full support for effortless
integration and superior performance.

### Pneumatics & Fluid Control

Where "off-the-shelf" pneumatic or fluid control solutions fail to deliver the optimal performance
your system requires, Youngblood Automation is your value-add partner. Our team brings expertise in
electro-pneumatic panels and assemblies, air logic control systems, custom valve manifolds, air
preparation assemblies, and more. Our in-house engineering and manufacturing teams will ensure your
fluid control or pneumatic application needs are satisfied with a design that maximizes performance
and efficiency.

### Robotics & Vision

Automation is possible for companies of all sizes with endless opportunities for integrating
robotics and vision into a variety of applications. Regardless of your industry, business size, or
product type, we can improve and complement your current system by applying our extensive experience
with collaborative robots and vision technology. Stay one step ahead of your competitors with
solutions built with the future in mind.

## Your Partner for Motion Control, Fluid Power, and Automation.

Youngblood Automation brings over 50 years of experience to the pneumatic, hydraulic,
electromechanical, safety, vision, and robotic automation industry. Youngblood Automation provides
solutions that enhance efficiency, reliability, and performance in a wide-variety of industries,
including industrial, automotive, factory automation, aerospace, defense, consumer goods, food &
packaging, steel, medical, and mobile. As a stocking distributor of leading component manufacturers,
with comprehensive application engineering and manufacturing capabilities, we are the ideal partner
for your motion control, fluid control, and automation requirements.

## Youngblood Automation Engineered Solutions 

At Youngblood Automation, we design and build durable, adaptable custom solutions to meet your exact
needs. From simple workstations, shelving, and protective enclosures to advanced robotic cell
guarding and conveyor systems, our expert Engineered Solutions team collaborates with you to create
the perfect fit.

We partner with leading manufacturers like MayTec and Troax to deliver high-quality components for
automation and industrial applications. With our expertise and industry-leading partners, we bring
your vision to life—delivering innovative, high-performance solutions that enhance safety,
efficiency, and productivity 

[Explore Our Solutions][46]

## Youngblood Automation Value Added Engineering 

At Youngblood Automation, we deliver innovative solutions to meet the ever-evolving demands of
automation. With deep industry expertise, we help optimize performance, enhance reliability, and
extend the lifespan of your automation systems. From pneumatics and hydraulics to motion control,
vision, safety, and robotics, our engineering team identifies opportunities and overcomes challenges
to keep your operations running efficiently. 
* Industrial Hydraulics & Lubrication 
* Mobile Products 
* Motion Control & Automation 
* Pneumatics & Fluid Control 

[Explore Our Solutions][47]

## Youngblood Automation Solutions

### Motion Control & Automation

Youngblood Automation is dedicated to helping our clients keep up with the ever-changing demands of
automation with solutions tailored to their unique performance objectives and budgetary constraints.
Our engineering team can help simplify your application and fulfill even the most complex system
with our motion control solutions and components.

### Industrial/Mobile Hydraulics Systems & Lubrication

With more than five decades of experience and access to a wide range of manufacturer components,
Youngblood Automation can serve your needs across industrial or mobile hydraulics systems and
lubrication. Offering hydraulic power units, electro-hydraulic controls, manifold assemblies,
lubrication and filtration systems, and more. When you work with Youngblood Automation you can be
confident that your solution is engineered and tested to address your specific application needs.

### Safety, Sensors & Vision

Ensure the protection of your industrial operations with Youngblood Automation's advanced safety,
sensors, and vision solutions. Whether it be in manufacturing or logistics automation, our team's
expertise guarantees effective process control that prioritizes safety for individuals and the
environment. Count on our dedication to providing groundbreaking solutions customized to your
automation requirements. With our knowledgeable team, you can expect full support for effortless
integration and superior performance.

### Pneumatics & Fluid Control

Where "off-the-shelf" pneumatic or fluid control solutions fail to deliver the optimal performance
your system requires, Youngblood Automation is your value-add partner. Our team brings expertise in
electro-pneumatic panels and assemblies, air logic control systems, custom valve manifolds, air
preparation assemblies, and more. Our in-house engineering and manufacturing teams will ensure your
fluid control or pneumatic application needs are satisfied with a design that maximizes performance
and efficiency.

### Robotics & Vision

Automation is possible for companies of all sizes with endless opportunities for integrating
robotics and vision into a variety of applications. Regardless of your industry, business size, or
product type, we can improve and complement your current system by applying our extensive experience
with collaborative robots and vision technology. Stay one step ahead of your competitors with
solutions built with the future in mind.

## ZennoPoster

ZennoPoster is intended for SEO pros, webmasters and other users that are engaged in intense
activity in the web. The app supports recording human actions across web resources (forms filling,
links clicking) and reiterate them across tens and hundreds of threads (Professional Version).
It also ensures anonymity via proxy that are processed by powerful proxy checker

[ Learn more ][39]
[ZennoPoster program interface]
[CapMonster Cloud interface]
[CapMonster Cloud logo]

## CapMonster Cloud

CapMonster Cloud is the advanced AI-powered solution for fast, reliable, cost-effective CAPTCHA
solving. It easily handles reCAPTCHA, Cloudflare, Amazon WAF, GeeTest, and other CAPTCHA types. At
least 2x cheaper and up to 30x faster than other services. Works with any program and doesn’t
require installation, proxies, or servers. Simple, fast, and hassle-free!

[ Learn more ][40]
[ZennoBrowser logo]

## ZennoBrowser

A modern anti-detection browser for managing multiple accounts and automating tasks. ZennoBrowser
allows you to create an unlimited number of local profiles on any plan, isolate sessions, and manage
them all from a single interface. It provides a high level of anonymity thanks to unique digital
fingerprints and proxies, and easily integrates with ZennoPoster for building complex automation
scenarios.

[ Learn more ][41]
[ZennoBrowser program interface]
[ZennoDroid program interface]
[ZennoDroid logo]

## ZennoDroid

In ZennoDroid you can record actions performed with a mouse on virtual Android screen and
then replay these actions in the same order. This will look as if you swipe the screen of your
smartphone with your finger. The app includes the capability to change proxy and setup a number of
system parameters so that you could appear every time as a different device

[ Learn more ][42]
[CapMonster logo]

## CapMonster

CapMonster — a software solution intended for  captcha recognition powered by the cutting-edge OCR
algorithms. The program already includes a database of ready-made recognition modules for the most
popular captchas, which is constantly updated. You can also develop your own recognition modules for
virtually any captcha, even the most sophisticated one

[ Learn more ][43]
[CapMonster program interface]
[ZennoProxyChecker program interface]
[ZennoProxyChecker logo]
